text: Structuring Securities Regulation in the European Union predicts a domestic home bias in enforcement decisions that makes extraterritorial actions less likely and reduces incentives to comply. This supplies a countervailing under-enforcement risk to Kaal's warning against overbroad extraterritorial rule export. The abstract does not identify the optimal jurisdictional boundary or measure actual compliance effects.
